convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin' which is a custom spectral analysis indicator not available as built-in MT5 indicator. Also depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management, money management, and new bar detection.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of the indicator timeframe
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
tnn1 - FFT window size derived from N

other_exits: Opposite signal closes position: when Value[1]>Value[2] (downtrend detected), BuyPosClose triggers; when Value[1]<Value[2] (uptrend detected), SellPosClose triggers

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM parameter meaning changes based on MMMode selected.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses spectral analysis (FFT-based) of Chaikin Oscillator. Entry logic is two-condition AND: (1) Value[1] vs Value[2] determines trend direction (rising=up, falling=down), and (2) Value[0] vs Value[1] confirms momentum continuation (Value[0]>=Value[1] for long, Value[0]<=Value[1] for short). The three buffer values are read from SignalBar offset: Value[0]=current signal bar, Value[1]=1 bar before signal, Value[2]=2 bars before signal. Signal gating is controlled by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans. When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated every tick instead of only on new bars.
python_conversion_notes: The custom indicator i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin must be reimplemented in Python - it performs spectral (FFT) analysis of Chaikin Oscillator with inverse FFT reconstruction using only N largest harmonics, then smoothed by SS-period MA. Requires numpy FFT functions. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_ - all must be reimplemented. Position sizing has 5 modes (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) that change how the MM input parameter is interpreted. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - 1000 and 2000 respectively, which may need digit-adjustment depending on broker. The Chaikin Oscillator itself is: fast_MA(AD) - slow_MA(AD) where AD = Accumulation/Distribution, then FFT is applied to this oscillator output.
